Our people put our stakeholders at the heart of everything they do by helping us to make a positive difference to the lives of our clients, customers, colleagues, shareholders, and society. Our Adviser business provides financial planning solutions and technology for UK financial advisers, enabling them to create value for their customers. Our Investments business is a specialist asset manager that focuses on areas where we have both strength and scale to capitalise on the key themes shaping the market, through either public markets or alternative asset classes. About The Department Infrastructure Services provides the secure, resilient and scalable technology foundations that support Aberdeen’s business and client services. Working closely with Architecture, Security, Cloud and Operations teams, the department drives modernisation, operational resilience and service excellence. The team fosters collaboration, continuous improvement and technical leadership, enabling our clients to be better investors through dependable infrastructure services. About The Role We are seeking a Lead Storage & Backup Engineer to provide technical leadership across enterprise storage, backup, recovery and cyber resilience services. Reporting to the Head of Infrastructure Services, you will own the engineering direction for Cohesity DataProtect, Azure backup and storage platforms, recovery assurance and infrastructure resilience capabilities. This is an opportunity to influence strategy, modernise critical services and lead high-impact initiatives across regulated technology environments. The role offers significant exposure across architecture, security, operations and supplier management, helping you invest in your tomorrow through meaningful technical leadership. Key Responsibilities Act as the technical authority for storage, backup, recovery and cyber resilience technologies, defining standards and engineering best practice. Lead the design, implementation and continual improvement of Cohesity DataProtect, Azure backup and enterprise storage platforms. Drive recovery assurance, cyber recovery and ransomware recovery testing to improve resilience and recoverability outcomes. Partner with Architecture, Security, Cloud and Operations teams to deliver strategic roadmaps, automation and platform modernisation initiatives. Provide governance, supplier oversight and technical leadership for complex incidents, major changes and regulatory requirements. Reduce operational complexity, technical debt and cost through optimisation, simplification and Infrastructure as Code approaches. About The Candidate Strong hands-on experience with Cohesity DataProtect or other Backup infrastructure like Veritas, Veeam, Rubrik for example across administration, engineering and troubleshooting across enterprise workloads. Proven expertise in enterprise backup, recovery, replication, immutability and cyber resilience solutions. Strong experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure, Azure Backup, Recovery Services Vaults and storage services. Other cloud environment experience is also considered (AWS or GCP) Knowledge of enterprise storage platforms, SAN, NAS, replication, performance optimisation and capacity planning. Experience developing technical standards, solution designs, automation and Infrastructure as Code practices. Desirable criteria : Cohesity certifications; Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-104 or AZ-305; experience with Veritas NetBackup, Rubrik or similar platforms; Financial Services experience; and integration with monitoring, ITSM, CMDB and reporting tooling. We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you have a disability and would like to apply to one of our UK roles under the Disability Confident Scheme, please notify us by completing the relevant section in our candidate questionnaire. One of our team will reach out to support you through your application process. We want you to be the real you throughout our recruitment process. Sharing your diversity information helps us understand the reach and impact of our hiring practices, and build a workplace where all people can thrive and belong. This information is kept separate from your application and is not visible to recruiters, hiring managers, or assessors at any stage. Our Benefits There's more to working life than coming home with a good salary. We have an environment where you can learn, get involved and be supported. When you join us, your reward will be one of the best around. This includes 40 days’ annual leave, a 16% employer pension contribution, a discretionary performance-based bonus (where applicable), private healthcare and a range of flexible benefits – including gym discounts, season ticket loans and access to an employee discount portal. You can read more about our benefits here. Our business Enabling our clients to be better investors drives everything we do. Our business is structured around three distinct areas – our vectors of growth – focused on our clients’ changing needs. You can find out more about what we do here. An inclusive way of working Whatever way you like to work, if you have the talent and commitment to join our team, we’d like to hear from you. At Aberdeen we’ve adopted a ‘blended working’ approach. This approach combines the benefits of face-to-face collaboration, coaching and connecting in our offices with the flexibility of working from home. It enables colleagues to find a balance that works for their roles, their teams, our clients and our business. An inclusive culture, where diverse perspectives drive our actions, is at the core of who we are and what we do. If you need assistance with your application, or a reasonable adjustment to your interview arrangements – for example, because you are neurodivergent, or have a physical, sensory, cognitive, mental, visible or invisible disability – please let us know and we’ll be happy to help. #aberdeenplcjobs We’re committed to providing an inclusive workplace where all forms of difference are valued and which is free from any form of unfair or unlawful treatment. We define diversity in its broadest sense – this includes but is not limited to our diversity of educational and professional backgrounds, experience, cognitive and neurodiversity, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or belief and ethnicity and geographical provenance. We support a culture that values meritocracy, fairness and transparency and welcomes enquiries from everyone. If you need assistance or an adjustment due to a disability please let us know as part of your application and we will assist.

Je zorgt voor een veilige, stabiele en gebruiksvriendelijke digitale werkomgeving en helpt collega’s hun applicaties optimaal te benutten. Je werkt op twee goed bereikbare kantoorlocaties, nabij station Amsterdam Zuid en Rotterdam Centraal , en schakelt met IT-collega’s en externe partners binnen een organisatie met platformen in Europa en Azië. Dit is een hands-on functie met veel zelfstandigheid, direct contact met gebruikers en ruimte om bij te dragen aan verdere digitalisering en de inzet van AI-tools. Je bent regelmatig aanwezig op beide kantoorlocaties. Wat ga je doen? Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor het dagelijkse beheer, onderhoud en de ondersteuning van Microsoft 365 en Google Workspace. Je biedt persoonlijke ondersteuning aan eindgebruikers en helpt hen digitale tools effectief te gebruiken. Je implementeert en bewaakt beveiligingsmaatregelen om gevoelige gegevens te beschermen. Je draagt zorg voor naleving van relevante wet- en regelgeving, beveiligingsstandaarden en interne richtlijnen. Je beheert de kantoor-IT-infrastructuur en zorgt voor goed functionerende en veilige WiFi-netwerken en endpointapparatuur. Je werkt samen met IT-collega’s, lokale IT-verantwoordelijken en key users binnen de internationale organisatie. Je stemt werkzaamheden af met externe IT-leveranciers en bewaakt de kwaliteit en continuïteit van de dienstverlening. Je helpt collega’s om Gemini en Claude AI toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Hiervoor ontvang je training. Wat breng je mee? Minimaal vijf jaar hands-on ervaring met support en/of applicatiebeheer van Microsoft 365 en Google Workspace. Gedegen technische kennis van beide omgevingen. Aantoonbare kennis van cybersecurity best practices en relevante compliance-standaarden. Sterke communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden: je maakt technologie begrijpelijk en helpt collega’s graag verder. Een proactieve, zelfstandige werkhouding en een praktische aanpak bij het oplossen van problemen. Vloeiende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels. Bereidheid om op beide kantoorlocaties in Amsterdam en Rotterdam te werken. Wat kun je verwachten? Een marktconform salaris en een passend pakket secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Een veelzijdige functie van 40 uur per week binnen een internationale, diverse en groeiende organisatie. Veel zelfstandigheid en de mogelijkheid om zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de digitale werkomgeving. Ruimte voor professionele ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen de organisatie en haar internationale platformen. Training in Gemini en Claude AI en de kans om de adoptie van deze tools te ondersteunen. Een collegiale werkomgeving met korte lijnen.
